headline: Stanley Electric Co., Ltd discloses substantial acquisition of Lumax Industries under SEBI Takeover Code
sum: Stanley Electric Co., Ltd has filed a formal disclosure under SEBI Takeover Regulations Regulation 31(4) with NSE regarding a substantial acquisition of shares in Lumax Industries Limited. The filing indicates a material shareholding event requiring mandatory public disclosure under the takeover framework.
detail: Stanley Electric Co., Ltd, a Japanese automotive components manufacturer, has submitted formal disclosure to NSE under Regulation 31(4) of the SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011. This disclosure is mandatory when an acquirer crosses material shareholding thresholds. Lumax Industries is a major Indian automotive components and industrial engineering group. The filing marks the commencement of formal regulatory notification and potential trigger for further acquisition-related declarations under the takeover code.
